purpose: Historical index of exact critical-feature commits, evidence scope and focused failure checks. It is not a mandatory blanket checklist; use only checks relevant to the current failure and reuse still-valid results.

entries.subject: Stabilize wake tail and diagnostic retention
protects: Auxiliary strict/offline wake checks do not evict the startup-prewarmed sensitive live KWS runtime.
Runtime cache identity includes prefix-variant behavior as well as phrase, score and threshold.
Wake latency distinguishes deliberate activation-phrase duration from the processing tail after the detected phrase end.
Default wake diagnostic WAVs are asynchronously bounded across process restarts by age, count and bytes without deleting unrelated files.

entries.subject: Add preproduction repo hygiene gates
protects: Dirty work must be classified before final review or release.
Final Type review/release must fail on a dirty worktree.
Human review shows overall progress and stops when an operator note needs triage.
MSI validation launches the installed Program Files app instead of a repo exe.

entries.subject: Restore Type recording latency guards
protects: Recording preview and final text stay near-zero-latency after Type restart or MSI install.
Volcengine preview stays a low-latency sidecar while final ASR remains accurate.
Recording stop/control commands do not re-enter the high-volume BLE notification FIFO.
Recording capsule partial preview preserves the latest audio level instead of forcing zero.

entries.subject: Harden installed desktop shortcut refresh
protects: An MSI update leaves one visible Listener Type desktop shortcut, not duplicate common- and user-desktop entries.
The surviving desktop shortcut targets the installed Program Files executable and is reread before packaging reports success.
MSI validation restarts the installed application instead of a repository build.

entries.subject: Stabilize recording preview text
protects: Recording capsule partial text grows without rewriting the visible prefix when final and preview ASR disagree on punctuation.
Punctuation-only ASR revisions do not cause the capsule text to jump.
Shorter ASR partial revisions do not shrink already visible recording preview text.

entries.subject: Use observed address for Type recovery
protects: EC11 double-click with Type clears stale pairing and re-pairs through the Type-observed recovery address instead of repeating slow advertisement scans.
Type recovery reaches notify ready and Type heartbeat within the 20s acceptance ceiling.
EC11 single-click recording start/stop stays separate from double-click recovery.
Recovery capsule messages stay short while the shared PairAsync/GATT/notify path remains visible in logs.

entries.subject: Recover Type after Listener boot
protects: Type reconnects after a Listener boot without consuming the first recording press as a recovery-only action.
A successful read-only GATT probe may clear a transient false manual-unpair hold without invoking PairAsync.
The no-Type/manual-delete path remains user controlled and background recovery does not open pairing UI.

entries.subject: Stabilize Type device settings keys
protects: Type writes exact low-power minutes instead of turning values such as 12 into 13.
Type syncs firmware readback values into local preferences exactly.
Default device key output stays KEY1 RightCtrl, KEY2 Ctrl+C, KEY3 Ctrl+V, KEY4 Enter (operator updated KEY4 on 2026-10-01).
Device custom-key UI keeps a single recorder control while preserving dictation/custom function choices.
machine_accepted_scope: Operator delegated the brightness/low-power acceptance to installed-Type UI automation on 2026-07-12.
Random UI values wrote and read back exactly; firmware NVS and an actual low-power LED frame matched; original personal values were restored through the same UI.
pending_human_scope: Custom-key interaction behavior remains a separate review item.

entries.subject: Harden Type lifecycle validation scripts
protects: Lifecycle validation uses pwsh instead of Windows PowerShell.
Startup/window lifecycle tests protect reopening hidden or tiny main windows.
UI config tests protect the device-key recorder-only control and default key output.

entries.subject: Clean Type pwsh entrypoints
protects: Public Type docs and release commands use pwsh -NoProfile entrypoints.
Packaging, BLE recovery, OTA recovery, embedded audio replay, and diagnostics helpers do not invoke Windows PowerShell 5.1 or carry execution-policy shims.
Type runtime Windows App Runtime detection uses pwsh instead of powershell.exe.
Missing pwsh is reported as environment failure instead of silently falling back to Windows PowerShell.

entries.subject: Harden firmware validation tooling
protects: Firmware release_check fails early on a dirty worktree.
Firmware validation tooling stays on pwsh and avoids recurring PowerShell 5.1 fallbacks.
send_serial_and_capture.ps1 accepts -CaptureSeconds as a safe shorthand.

entries.subject: Clean firmware public docs and tool entrypoints
protects: Open-source firmware tree does not track bulky legacy !docs prose archives.
Schematics live under normal docs/schematics instead of !docs.
Public docs and helper scripts use pwsh -NoProfile entrypoints instead of Windows PowerShell execution-policy shims.
IDF access stays behind tools/idf.ps1 except for that wrapper and idf_env diagnostics.
Generated hardware and human validation evidence defaults to .cache/validation instead of tracked docs.

entries.subject: Stabilize firmware LED power cues
protects: PWR boot starts warm amber and only hands off after BLE-visible readiness.
Shutdown confirmation preserves visible PWR/status frames instead of intermittently blacking out.
EC11 push suppresses rotation so straight presses do not produce rotation side effects.
Processing/AI LED has a stale timeout and idle-wake recording key evidence stays checkable.
accepted_scope: Human review accepted PWR boot warm amber first frame, truthful BLE-ready handoff to normal PWR state, EC11 straight press not decoding as rotation, and shutdown confirmation/EC11 long-press continuity.

2026-07-12 total acceptance reconfirmed that startup is measured from the PWR amber cue to stable visible BLE readiness, not an early normal-PWR color; the observed current startup speed is acceptable.
pending_human_scope: AI/processing LED stale-timeout behavior and idle-wake recording key remain machine-validated pending focused human acceptance.

entries.subject: Stabilize firmware BLE settings recovery
protects: Compact device settings keys preserve exact low-power and brightness values.
BLE advertising/secure connection can release the truthful PWR boot handoff.
pwsh BLE/HID validation loads the WinRT BLE projection before checking HID recovery.
BLE diagnostic coverage remains visible for rename/recovery regressions.

entries.subject: Stabilize firmware BLE audio transport
protects: BLE audio backpressure uses low-latency queue/pool thresholds before emergency pressure fallback.
Type-ready BLE audio events refresh power activity and can participate in truthful startup readiness.
BLE audio product matrix and host recovery helpers stay on pwsh and keep their product-chain case catalog valid.

entries.subject: Remove bulky LED history doc
protects: Old LED DMA/flicker history prose is not a required maintenance input.
Status LED transport constraints live in code contracts, static verifiers, and this JSON index instead of a bulky MD history file.

entries.subject: Validate key DMA and dark RMT latch together
protects: KEY lit feedback frames stay on SPI DMA, including the accepted white-to-purple single-click transition.
RMT may only write the final two-frame all-dark latch after a SPI DMA pre-latch; it must never drive a lit KEY frame.
Multiple KEY effects retain independent fade behavior instead of clearing another active key.

entries.subject: Extract shared audio v1 core
protects: VKA1 packet fields, packet/error codes, and 16 kHz mono PCM constants have one generated protocol source.
Shared Rust session parsing preserves the accepted recording packet, tail-audio, silence-fill, and preview-boundary behavior.
Embedded C packet layout and constructor remain byte-compatible with the desktop core.

entries.subject: Use shared audio v1 core
protects: Type has no second copy of the VKA1 parser or session collector.
Existing recording callers link against the Denzic Platform audio core.

entries.subject: Use shared audio v1 protocol
protects: Firmware VKA1 constants, packed packet header, and constructor come from the Denzic Platform generated C contract.
Existing Firmware protocol names stay compatible while the platform source remains authoritative.

entries.subject: Restore persisted GATT before recovery advertising
protects: Changing a random Listener name back to listener uses the same cache-cleanup, PairAsync, GATT, notify and heartbeat recovery path as any other changed name.
Cached Swift Pair metadata never preempts a working persisted GATT/CCCD path or sends the recovery flow down an unnecessary PairAsync branch.
The installed Type reconnects to listener without a local pairing prompt and reaches notify ready within the 3 s startup guard.

entries.subject: Keep silent Type recovery open until re-pair
protects: A pre-reset Type audio event cannot close a new silent re-pair window before the old connection disconnects.
Firmware leaves recovery SMP ownership to Windows PairAsync and keeps unbonded Type-ready recovery silent.
A concurrent disconnect reported as BLE_HS_EALREADY remains a valid recovery transition instead of an error path.

entries.subject: Respect manual Windows Bluetooth removal
protects: After a user manually removes Listener in Windows, Type must not invoke PairAsync to reclaim that computer.
A persisted GATT path must not reopen the audio listener or emit Listener 音频已恢复 until Windows reports a confirmed new pairing.
The held state may show a bounded manual-pairing cue, while rename and Type-owned recovery retain their separate recovery path.

entries.subject: Advertise native pairing during recovery
protects: With Listener Type fully exited, Windows native Add device pairs Listener without any Type PairAsync path.
A native pair exposes the Listener BTHLE node plus HID service 00001812 and a COL01 keyboard.inf/kbdhid keyboard path.
Native recovery remains a bounded user-controlled pairing path instead of a connected/disconnected loop.

entries.subject: Listener build source snapshot
protects: Discover recovery command set from real Type callers, execute firmware queue-completion code, and consume its actual success/error lines through the real Type parser.

Queue admission is not execution completion; exact requested command and USB source remain mandatory. Stable recovery must not fall through to false BLE retries merely because only FRESH emits an ACK.
Retain the latest actual ENSURE handler result across STOP/ABORT for diagnosis; this observation never grants stream ownership.

entries.subject: Writable native Document ordinary-paste receipts without granting range mutation
protects: Explicit native VT_BOOL read-only=false plus Document/TextPattern/foreground/focus/enabled is sufficient for ordinary-paste observation without ValuePattern.
Mixed, NotSupported, numeric/string coercion and conflicting read-only evidence stay rejected; no new whole-range editing permission.

entries.subject: Native finalized clause rendering does not depend on an editor consumed-spelling seam
protects: Current definite=true two_pass clauses with valid nonempty timed occurrences can certify complete already-admitted rendering, including short/ITN-corrected clauses.
Per-word source and identity certificates remain strict; provisional/missing/conflicting/overlapping occurrences remain unresolved; delivery and STOP are separate.

entries.subject: Pin original wake source while the same predecessor BLE tail drains
protects: Same predecessor physical EOF/TRANSFERRING and Idle-before-transport-ready retain the already qualified original source under the same request.
The ordinary unowned checkpoint age and fixed ENSURE deadline do not increase.
Cancellation, expiry and unavailable original source revoke only the matching pending continuation; explicit/manual/enrollment owners stay protected.

protects: Full 21px network badge with top shadow clearance at normal and translation layouts
Network animation does not overwrite horizontal centering
Default normal pill position and saved user drag bottom remain stable while status space grows upward
No ASR, dictation, clipboard, BLE or network policy change

entries.subject: Reuse actual same-media transport/job blocking in the bounded pacing allowance
protects: An admission/retry or post-job real Blocked interval must not be charged again for the same ordinary media quantum.
Credit stays bounded to the existing single early tick; no banking of a long pause, cross-worker/source/link grant or borrowing from exempt preroll.
Keep controller/msys admission, actual IDLE0 opportunities, original PCM/sequence, source leases and endpoint/keyword/identity policy.
limits: Seven natural physical audio sessions match device counts/PCM at actual application reception, including one cancel; activation intent and semantic text/endpoint correctness are not human-confirmed.
First2s historical audio still arrives in743..2057ms; new BLE connection/content differs from pre22, so no controlled causal end-to-end speedup claimed.
Raw OTA160KB/s and full interference/early-end stability remain incomplete.
